Hi Brad. I've reviewed Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH Priya and Marcus are free for a 30-minute meeting:

- Monday: 09:00-10:00 (slots: 09:00 or 09:30)
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00 (slots: 13:00 or 13:30), 16:30-17:00 (slot: 16:30)
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00 (slots: 15:00 or 15:30)
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30 (slot: 10:00)
- Friday: 11:00-12:00 (slots: 11:00 or 11:30)

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for both of them. Preferably suggest the earliest available slot.
